summary.zh: 最常见的用法。缩放时 Sharp 让 mozjpeg 按 1/2、1/4 或 1/8 直接缩小解码，EXIF 与 ICC 配置在读文件头时就被解析。
summary.en: The most common use. When resizing, Sharp asks mozjpeg to decode at 1/2, 1/4 or 1/8 scale; EXIF and ICC are parsed while the header is read.

note.zh: ③ 把选项交给原生模块
note.en: ③ hands the options to the native module

note.zh: ② 需要缩小时用 `shrink` 重新打开 JPEG
note.en: ② reopens the JPEG with `shrink` when downscaling

note.zh: 按魔数选择加载器，不看文件名
note.en: picks the loader from magic bytes, not the file name

note.zh: 设置 `exif-data` 时自动解析
note.en: setting `exif-data` triggers parsing

label.zh: 文件带 ICC 配置（APP2）时，在 `src/pipeline.cc` 中
label.en: when the file carries an ICC profile (APP2), in `src/pipeline.cc`

note.zh: 默认转换到 sRGB
note.en: converts to sRGB by default

out.zh: 之后的缩放与 `webpsave.c` → libwebp 编码处理的是已解码的像素，不属于 Tier 0。
out.en: Resizing and `webpsave.c` → libwebp encoding afterwards work on decoded pixels and are outside Tier 0.

summary.zh: 很多服务在接收上传时先调用 `.metadata()` 做校验，这一步就已经在解析不可信的文件头和元数据块。
summary.en: Many services call `.metadata()` to validate an upload first. That call already parses the untrusted header and metadata chunks.

note.zh: ① 交给原生模块
note.en: ① hands over to the native module

label.en: when the file has an `eXIf` chunk

note.zh: 经由 `vips_image_set` 触发
note.en: triggered through `vips_image_set`

note.zh: libpng 解压 `iCCP`、`zTXt`、`iTXt` 块
note.en: libpng inflates `iCCP`, `zTXt`, `iTXt` chunks

summary.zh: 文件名不起作用：内容是 TIFF 就进 libtiff，TIFF 里的 JPEG 或 Deflate 数据再交给 mozjpeg 或 zlib-ng。
summary.en: The file name does nothing: TIFF content goes to libtiff, and JPEG or Deflate data inside the TIFF goes on to mozjpeg or zlib-ng.

note.zh: ① 前面的 JS 与 `PipelineWorker` 同上一条链
note.en: ① the JS and `PipelineWorker` steps are as in the first chain

label.zh: 瓦片用 JPEG 压缩时

note.zh: Deflate 压缩的条带，经 libtiff 的 `tif_zip.c`
note.en: Deflate strips, through libtiff's `tif_zip.c`

summary.zh: WebP 先由解复用器拆出帧与 EXIF、ICC 块，再交给 libwebp 解码；`rotate()` 会用到 EXIF 中的方向。
summary.en: The demuxer splits WebP into frames and EXIF/ICC chunks before libwebp decodes it; `rotate()` uses the EXIF orientation.

label.en: when the file has an `EXIF` chunk

out.zh: `vips2jpeg.c` → mozjpeg 编码处理的是已解码的像素，不属于 Tier 0。
out.en: `vips2jpeg.c` → mozjpeg encoding works on decoded pixels and is outside Tier 0.

summary.zh: Sharp 的 GIF 解码完全在 libvips 内置的 libnsgif 里，没有外部 GIF 库。
summary.en: Sharp decodes GIF entirely with the libnsgif copy inside libvips; there is no external GIF library.

note.zh: libvips 内置的 libnsgif（含 `lzw.c`）
note.en: the libnsgif copy inside libvips (with `lzw.c`)

out.zh: 输出仍是 GIF，由 `cgifsave.c` → cgif 编码，不属于 Tier 0。
out.en: The output stays GIF and is encoded by `cgifsave.c` → cgif, outside Tier 0.

summary.zh: libvips 把 SVG 加载器标为不可信，但 Sharp 默认接受；librsvg 用 Rust 写成，XML 却由 libxml2 的 C 代码解析。
summary.en: libvips marks the SVG loader untrusted, but Sharp accepts it by default; librsvg is Rust, yet the XML is parsed by libxml2's C code.

note.zh: Rust 代码，通过 FFI 调用 libxml2
note.en: Rust code calling libxml2 through FFI

out.zh: 之后 `rsvg_handle_render_document` 用 cairo 栅格化，不属于 Tier 0。
out.en: Rasterising with cairo through `rsvg_handle_render_document` follows and is outside Tier 0.

summary.zh: `Image.open` 只读文件头；`thumbnail()` 先调用 `draft()` 让 libjpeg-turbo 缩小解码，再在 `load()` 里真正解码。
summary.en: `Image.open` reads only the header; `thumbnail()` calls `draft()` so libjpeg-turbo decodes at reduced scale, then decodes for real in `load()`.

code.zh:
from PIL import Image

with Image.open(upload) as im:     # ① 逐个插件检查魔数，只解析文件头
    im.thumbnail((800, 800))       # ② draft() 设定缩放，load() 才解码
    im.save(out, "WEBP")
code.en:
from PIL import Image

with Image.open(upload) as im:     # ① every plugin checks the magic bytes; header only
    im.thumbnail((800, 800))       # ② draft() sets the scale, load() decodes
    im.save(out, "WEBP")

note.zh: ① 依次调用每个插件的 `_accept`
note.en: ① calls every plugin's `_accept` in turn

note.zh: JPEG 标记在 Python 中解析
note.en: JPEG markers are parsed in Python

note.zh: ② 取得名为 `jpeg` 的解码器
note.en: ② obtains the `jpeg` decoder

out.zh: 之后的 `Resample.c` 与 `_webp.c` → libwebp 编码处理的是已解码的像素，不属于 Tier 0。
out.en: `Resample.c` and `_webp.c` → libwebp encoding afterwards work on decoded pixels and are outside Tier 0.

summary.zh: Pillow 不用 libpng：块在 Python 里解析，像素数据由 Pillow 自己的 `ZipDecode.c` 交给 zlib-ng 解压。
summary.en: Pillow does not use libpng: chunks are parsed in Python and pixel data is inflated by Pillow's own `ZipDecode.c` with zlib-ng.

code.zh:
from PIL import Image

im = Image.open(upload)       # ① PNG 块在 Python 中解析
rgb = im.convert("RGB")       # ② load()：用 zip 解码器解压像素
code.en:
from PIL import Image

im = Image.open(upload)       # ① PNG chunks are parsed in Python
rgb = im.convert("RGB")       # ② load(): the zip decoder inflates pixels

note.zh: ① `iCCP`、`zTXt` 用 Python 标准库 `zlib` 解压
note.en: ① `iCCP` and `zTXt` are inflated with Python's standard `zlib`

note.zh: ② 取得名为 `zip` 的解码器
note.en: ② obtains the `zip` decoder

note.zh: 解压后还原 PNG 行过滤
note.en: undoes PNG row filters after inflating

title.zh: 伪装成其他格式的 TIFF

summary.zh: TIFF 目录在 Python 中解析，压缩数据交给 libtiff；libtiff 再按压缩方式调用 liblzma、libjpeg-turbo 或 zlib-ng。
summary.en: The TIFF directory is parsed in Python and compressed data goes to libtiff, which calls liblzma, libjpeg-turbo or zlib-ng depending on the compression.

code.zh:
from PIL import Image

im = Image.open(upload)   # ① 文件名随意，内容是 TIFF
im.load()                 # ② 压缩的 TIFF 交给 libtiff 解码
code.en:
from PIL import Image

im = Image.open(upload)   # ① any file name; the bytes are a TIFF
im.load()                 # ② compressed TIFF is decoded by libtiff

note.zh: ② 取得名为 `libtiff` 的解码器
note.en: ② obtains the `libtiff` decoder

note.zh: Pillow 自己的内存读取回调
note.en: Pillow's own in-memory read callbacks

summary.zh: Pillow 对静态 WebP 也使用 libwebp 的动画解码器。
summary.en: Pillow uses libwebp's animation decoder even for still WebP images.

code.zh:
from PIL import Image

im = Image.open(upload)   # ① 创建 WebPAnimDecoder
im.load()                 # ② 取出第一帧
code.en:
from PIL import Image

im = Image.open(upload)   # ① creates a WebPAnimDecoder
im.load()                 # ② fetches the first frame

summary.zh: GIF、PSD、TGA、SGI、PCX、FLI 等都由 Pillow 自己的 C 解码器处理，没有外部库，是 Pillow 独有的攻击面。
summary.en: GIF, PSD, TGA, SGI, PCX, FLI and others are decoded by Pillow's own C decoders with no external library: attack surface unique to Pillow.

code.zh:
from PIL import Image

im = Image.open(upload)   # ① 43 个插件都会被检查
im.load()                 # ② 用 Pillow 自己的 C 解码器
code.en:
from PIL import Image

im = Image.open(upload)   # ① all 43 plugins are tried
im.load()                 # ② decoded by Pillow's own C decoder

note.zh: ② 取得名为 `gif` 的解码器
note.en: ② obtains the `gif` decoder

note.zh: PSD、TGA、SGI 等对应 `PackDecode.c`、`TgaRleDecode.c`、`SgiRleDecode.c` 等
note.en: PSD, TGA, SGI and others map to `PackDecode.c`, `TgaRleDecode.c`, `SgiRleDecode.c` and so on

summary.zh: JPEG 2000 同样按魔数自动识别；Pillow 逐块调用 openjpeg 解码。
summary.en: JPEG 2000 is also recognised by magic bytes; Pillow decodes it tile by tile with openjpeg.

code.zh:
from PIL import Image

im = Image.open(upload)   # ① .jp2 与裸码流都会被识别
im.load()                 # ② 逐块解码
code.en:
from PIL import Image

im = Image.open(upload)   # ① .jp2 files and raw codestreams are both recognised
im.load()                 # ② decoded tile by tile

summary.zh: libavif 解析容器并做 YUV 到 RGB 的转换，AV1 码流本身由 dav1d 解码。
summary.en: libavif parses the container and converts YUV to RGB; the AV1 bitstream itself is decoded by dav1d.

code.zh:
from PIL import Image

im = Image.open(upload)   # ① 解析 AVIF 容器
im.load()                 # ② 解码第一帧并转成 RGB
code.en:
from PIL import Image

im = Image.open(upload)   # ① parses the AVIF container
im.load()                 # ② decodes the first frame and converts to RGB

note.zh: AV1 解码器，体量大且含汇编，不在计划内
note.en: AV1 decoder, large and partly assembly; not planned
